title: Infinitude of Amicable Pairs
exact_target: Are there infinitely many distinct pairs in which each integer is the sum of the other's proper positive divisors?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1501 (NUM-007). CC BY 4.0.
Germano D'Abramo, \emph{On Amicable Numbers With Different Parity}, arXiv:math/0501402v4 (2007), Section 1, definition of amicable numbers and the general infinitude question.
